summary: Hestia Insight Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a strategic divestiture: it transferred 100% of its wholly-owned subsidiary Hestia Investments Inc. — including operating assets, bank/brokerage accounts, contracts, and physical property — to its Chairman and President, Edward C. Lee, on July 31, 2026. The transfer was in full satisfaction of historical executive service and compensation claims, tied to Lee's retirement and succession planning. As additional stockholder consideration, the subsidiary and Lee granted record-date shareholders (April 30, 2026) a right to 20% of the subsidiary's net earnings, paid annually for 24 months post-closing. Multiple amendments set closing timelines and annual payment structure. The deal is notable for involving a related-party transfer; no independent valuation or fairness opinion was disclosed. Watch for related-party scrutiny and shareholder reaction to the profit-participation right's value versus the assets transferred.
